{{Quote|Tell me about feeling better.''"<br />"''I'd feel a whole lot better if you'd stop asking questions, and give me something to help me sleep.|M4 and [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]]|<ref name="OSG" />}}
'''M4''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] based on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="OSG" />

M4 worked in medical bay of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] ''Independence'' early in the Galactic Civil War. A wheeled [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with a pleasant voice designed to put patients at ease, M4 was programmed to perform medical evaluations on the cruiser's personnel.<ref name="OSG" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the droid treated [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] for recurring [[Dream/Legends|dreams]]. Finding issue with Farlander's attitude, the medical droid summoned its [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Rebel doctor (Independence)|counterpart]]. Unwilling to be removed from active duty, Captain Farlander inadvertently used a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince the doctor to overrule M4, prescribe him some sedatives, and release him for active duty.<ref name="OSG" />
